'''Thyswar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[S'kytri]] of the [[Lowland Clans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Skye/Legends|Skye]]. A member of the [[Supreme Council of the Highland Clans|Supreme Council]] that governed the planet, he resided in the planet's capital city, the [[City of the Winged People]].

==Biography==
A [[S'kytri]] of the [[Lowland Clans]], Thyswar served as a member of the [[Supreme Council of the Highland Clans|Supreme Council]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. At this time, the crazed [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] mutant, [[Zeta Magnus]] had brought a pathogen to Skye and unleashed it on her people, declaring himself [[Magister]] in the process. When [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his two [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Halagad Ventor]] were brought before the Council to discuss the future of the Tyrant which ruled over them, Thyswar voiced his shock and disdain for [[Patriarch (Skye)|Patriarch]] Klarymére's proclamation that the [[Outland Clan]]s might have a good reason to attack them based on the outdated bylaws that governed S'kytri society. Speaker [[Nebaél]] silenced Thyswar and reprimanded him for speaking out of turn and later granted the Patriarch and the Jedi permission to neutralize the self-appointed Magister.<ref name="swcw" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thyswar's name was first introduced in the ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' as a sample name for [[S'kytri]] characters.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> It was later used by [[Abel G. Peña]] in the novella ''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''.<ref name="swcw" />
